grid.tip: Tip: double-click any cell to mark P / A / H / L / HPL / WOT / HOT. WO and HO are computed automatically from the org calendar; pick a value to override or "—" to revert. A worker with both check-in and check-out in a day is classified by hours worked vs shift length: below 25% of shift → A (Absent), 25–50% → H (Half day), 50%+ → P (Present). A past day where the worker checked in but never checked out shows as M (Missed check-out) so HR can review and override before payroll.
